verdict.rationale: Brave documents a first-party playground where users can 'try out the Brave Search API endpoints in your browser' and select an endpoint to see its parameters (brave-search-api-docs-65). This sits alongside per-endpoint API reference pages (docs-47, docs-49, docs-62, docs-68) and copyable curl examples (docs-10), which together cover the core of an interactive, runnable reference. The playground's depth rests on a single line of description, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec (probe-3). missing for 10: detail on playground capabilities (e.g. live responses, code generation), evidence that the reference pages themselves embed runnable examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
